provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, 2026 races as played so far. Formula 1: every finishing order from Jolpica (Ergast), matched against the ESPN F1 scoreboard in every race; circuits from Wikipedia; Jolpica's Miami start (20:00Z) differs from ESPN's (17:00Z). NASCAR Cup Series: the 32 completed points races from the ESPN scoreboard, names and tracks from Wikipedia, which matches every winner; the Daytona 500, Coca-Cola 600 and Brickyard 400 full orders and grids from their Wikipedia pages, which match ESPN; the Daytona 500 lists its four non-qualifiers as not starting. IndyCar: all 18 races from the ESPN scoreboard, names and tracks from Wikipedia; the Indianapolis 500 grid and order from its Wikipedia page, which matches ESPN. Start times are UTC except a US evening start, given in local time. Grid positions are given where a source has them. Rankings are each driver's average finish across the season; odds to win are made up from them.
